> I'm asking because without Hyper the test prints "* We are completely uploaded and fine" Is Hyper replacing that part?

It is, yes. It is output by the `readwrite_upload()` function.

> I just found it a bit confusing because even with Hyper support the else can still be executed, right?

Yes it can. Like for non-HTTP protocols libcurl is built to support, when `conn->datastream` is not set and thus still a NULL pointer.
